mapper.sql: id, merchant_id, store_name, store_description, store_logo, contact_phone, contact_email, address, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into store (merchant_id, store_name, store_description, store_logo, contact_phone, contact_email, address, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{merchantId}, #{storeName}, #{storeDescription}, #{storeLogo}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{address}, #{status}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update store set store_name = #{storeName}, store_description = #{storeDescription}, store_logo = #{storeLogo}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, address = #{address}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
